business_model: Insurance brokerage earning commissions (inferred from the broker description)

technical_complexity.rationale: Quote comparison and policy management portal, with the hard part being insurer integrations and licensing, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Broker licensing and insurer relationships help a little but customers could switch brokers easily.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbents reacting. Later SME insurtechs such as Simplee and Zuru entered Mexico, dates unclear.

market_need_then: Contxto reported that more than 80 percent of Mexican SMEs lack insurance. This is a market statistic, not company traction.

branding.domain_note: Uses covela.mx per a directory entry, history not found

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Covela was a Mexico City SME insurance broker startup in YC Summer 2019 backed by a $150k YC investment. YC lists it as inactive, but no shutdown notice, date or reason was found, so the cause of the outcome is not public. The sources found date only to 2019.
notes: No company website is listed on YC. The Nilo Ventures Medium post appeared in search but could not be opened (HTTP 403), so any Nilo investment is unverified. The $150k is the standard YC deal reported by Contxto. Competitor search found no dated rivals near July 2019. Exit type is unknown because status Inactive rests on YC and database labels only.
